anchor.semantic_hook: Gratitude directed to a positive cause is staged as an offering aimed toward a cause pedestal beside the successful outcome.
anchor.setting: A broad civic atrium contains a cause pedestal, an outcome table, high skylights, and open floor space for practical demonstrations. An enormous pair of stone hands rises from the floor and offers a laurel wreath directly toward the cause pedestal.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous pair of stone hands offering a wreath to the cause pedestal

inserts.action: leans over the cause pedestal and traces the route across the map with focused concentration
points with sudden relief from the end of the route toward the waiting restaurant table

variations.scene_adjust: place an unmarked street map on the cause pedestal and a set restaurant table at the far edge of the outcome area

inserts.action: sits comfortably at one home desk, working intently on a plain laptop
reclines at the second home desk and gestures appreciatively toward the network equipment

variations.scene_adjust: place two compact home desks, plain laptops, a wireless router, and branching network cables around the cause pedestal

inserts.action: sits upright at the practice steering wheel, checks both mirrors, and grips the controls with newly confident composure

variations.scene_adjust: place a driving-practice seat, steering wheel, mirrors, brake pedal, and a newly received car key beside the outcome table

inserts.action: strides across the atrium with a walking pole and looks eagerly toward the mountain trail
walks beside him with a light backpack, smiling up at the clear sky beyond the windows

variations.scene_adjust: lay a rugged indoor trail surface with potted alpine shrubs across the outcome area, place two ordinary hiking packs beside the cause pedestal, and admit clear sunlight through the skylights

inserts.action: sweeps the paved walkway briskly and gathers the last loose leaves into a pan

variations.scene_adjust: run a paved city walkway through the outcome area and place several brooms, pans, gloves, and sorted bins around the cause pedestal

inserts.action: fits the final piece into the project model and exhales with relief while checking the clock hand
steadies the model with both hands and offers the last needed tool with an encouraging smile

variations.scene_adjust: place an almost completed project model, two sets of tools, and an unnumbered clock with its hand just before a raised deadline marker on the outcome table

anchor.semantic_hook: Being worth the trouble is made literal by weighing each desired experience against a physical burden of hardship.
anchor.setting: A circular evaluation room contains an unnumbered balance, a preparation bench, an open reward bay, and a broad skyline window. The balance remains level while one tiny desired object opposes an entire mound of jagged hardship stones.
anchor.absurd_element: a tiny desired object balancing an entire mound of hardship stones

inserts.action: empties a heavy purse of plain coins onto the hardship pan and still leans eagerly toward the museum sculpture

variations.scene_adjust: place a museum sculpture and entrance token in the reward bay and a large pile of plain coins on the preparation bench

inserts.action: stands at the throwing line, raises a single dart with tentative resolve, and fixes his gaze on the target

variations.scene_adjust: place a plain practice target in the reward bay and leave only one dart at the throwing line

inserts.action: slumps exhausted over a scuffed suitcase at the end of the route, then lifts his head toward the destination with a satisfied smile

variations.scene_adjust: coil a long travel route across the floor, with worn luggage and muddy shoes on the hardship side and a welcoming destination arch in the reward bay

inserts.action: sits at the study bench wearing practice headphones, opens the second stack of study materials, and nods with determined interest

variations.scene_adjust: place a globe, practice headphones, and two separate stacks of closed unmarked language books around the preparation bench

inserts.action: relaxes his clenched hands, breathes steadily, and turns away from the tiny spilled objects with deliberate calm

variations.scene_adjust: scatter a bent paper clip, two loose buttons, and a few crumbs on the preparation bench, with the hardship stones left untouched

inserts.action: rests both hands on the balustrade and gazes contentedly across the domed skyline toward the setting sun

variations.scene_adjust: place a Gianicolo balustrade in the reward bay and raise the window shade to reveal Rome's domed skyline with the sun at the horizon

anchor.absurd_element: evidence objects traveling unsupported up a vertical stone lane

inserts.action: guides the victory trophy from the origin table toward the full circle of work gloves with an inclusive sweep of both arms

inserts.action: examines the misaligned shapes closely and points from the flawed sheet toward the carelessly dropped alignment ruler
